title: 第3章 九大皇族的联盟恐怖的强者第4章 教育从娃娃抓起取名为天
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
赢鸿一听始皇竟然想与冥界的所有势力，争夺冥界的天下，就不禁头皮发麻。
急忙劝阻道：“始皇先祖…我觉得咱们赢氏，现在最应该做的就是休养生息。”
“要是重启战端，冥界可能将再次生灵涂炭。”
“甚至可能出现，比现在的情况还严重的后果。”
“赢氏一族也可能会陷入水深火热之中啊~”
始皇闻言脸色顿时阴沉了下来冷哼道：“迂腐！愚蠢！你不想争夺天下，不代表别人也不想！”
“很多事情不是你不想，就可以不做的！”
“多数情况下，都只是被逼无奈之下的选择罢了…”
“想举世皆浊唯你独清，想跳出局外不在局中，你觉得可能吗？你有那种实力吗？”
“可…可是…”
赢鸿刚想反驳便被始皇打断。
“没有可是！这乃天下大势岂是你能阻挡的。”
“在这大势之中，就算是寡人也只能随波逐流。”
“想要在这大势之中活下去，唯有一个字…争！”
始皇看着欲言又止的赢鸿，淡淡的说道：“寡人知道你想说什么，不必多言。”
“好了，先不说这些事了，这天下也不是那么好争的，先积累实力不急于这一时。”
“现在，先来说说这孩子的问题。”
说完始皇便将目光放在了，正在熟睡的婴儿身上。
赢鸿闻言突然紧张道：“先祖，我儿怎么了？出了什么问题？”
“别紧张，这孩子身体好着呢。”

赢鸿闻言松了一口气，疑惑道：“那是什么问题？”
始皇皱着眉问道：“我从这孩子体内感受到，几股不同的血脉气息，其中还有八股是其他帝王皇室的嫡系血脉。”
“并且每一股血脉都极为不凡，正是这些血脉，才造就了这孩子，一出生便拥有了，堪称怪物般的天赋。”
“说说吧，怎么回事？寡人可不相信，这一切都是巧合。”
赢鸿闻言彻底的松了一口气。
心里吐槽，原来先祖要问的是这个，我还以为是什么呢，把我吓了个半死。
差点以为儿子，得了啥先天疾病。＜（￣3￣）＞哼！
赢鸿心里吐槽，道一番后说道：“回先祖，这事的确不是巧合。”
“事情还要从冥界降临后的，两百年前开始说起。”
“冥界降临后，所有人通过蓝星意志，得知了冥界之中的一些情报，和有关守护灵的情报后。”
“赢氏一族就与从龙国建立以来，就一直交好的其他八大皇族组成了联盟。”
“九大皇族在联盟后，纷纷动用各自能动用的一切人力物力。”
“合作寻找着，那些遗落在外，历朝历代所有能找到的文臣武将，奇人异士的后人的信息。”
始皇闻言满意的点头说道：“不错，这才有点皇族的风范，这个主意很好。”
赢鸿闻言嘴角微翘，始皇的评价让他也有种与有荣焉的自豪感。
停顿片刻后赢鸿随后继续说道。
“在寻找到一些文臣武将，奇人异士的后人的信息后。”
“九大皇族，就派出了当时各自族中，最为优秀的继承人。”
“前去游说拉拢，收服那些历史上的文臣武将，奇人异士的后人。”
content_en:
When Yinghong heard that the First Emperor actually wanted to compete with all the forces in the underworld for the world of the underworld, he couldn't help but feel numb.
He hurriedly tried to dissuade him: "Ancestor of the First Emperor... I think the most important thing for our Ying family to do now is to recuperate."
"If the war resumes, the underworld may once again be devastated."
"There may even be consequences that are more serious than the current situation."
"The Ying clan may also fall into dire straits~"
When the First Emperor heard this, his face suddenly darkened and he snorted coldly: "Pedantic! Stupid! Just because you don't want to fight for the world doesn't mean that others don't want to either!"
“You don’t have to do many things just because you don’t want to!”
"In most cases, it's just a choice made out of desperation..."
"If you want the whole world to be in trouble and you are the only one who is clear, if you want to get out of the game and not be in the game, do you think it's possible? Do you have that kind of strength?"
"But...but..."
Ying Hong was about to refute when he was interrupted by the First Emperor.
"There is no but! This is the general trend of the world. How can you stop it?"
"In this general trend, even a few people can only follow the trend."
"If you want to survive in this general trend, there is only one word... fight!"
The First Emperor looked at Yinghong who was hesitant to speak, and said calmly: "I know what you want to say, so there is no need to say more."
"Okay, let's not talk about these things for now. This world is not so competitive. Let's accumulate strength first and don't rush to this moment."
"Now, let's talk about this child's problem."
After speaking, the First Emperor turned his attention to the sleeping baby.
Hearing this, Yinghong suddenly said nervously: "Ancestor, what's wrong with my son? What's wrong?"
"Don't be nervous, the child is in good health."
Yinghong breathed a sigh of relief when he heard this and asked doubtfully: "What's the problem?"
The First Emperor frowned and asked, "I feel several different blood auras from this child's body, and eight of them are direct bloodlines from other emperors and royal families."
"And every bloodline is extremely extraordinary. It is these bloodlines that created this child. He has a monster-like talent right from birth."
"Tell me, what's going on? I don't believe it. It's all a coincidence."
Yinghong was completely relieved when he heard this.
I complained in my heart, it turned out that this is what the ancestor was asking, what did I think it was, it scared me half to death.
I almost thought my son had some congenital disease. ＜（￣3￣）＞Hmph!
Yinghong complained in his heart, and after some talk he said, "Back to my ancestors, this is indeed not a coincidence."
"Things will start after the arrival of the underworld, two hundred years ago."
"After the arrival of the underworld, everyone learned some information about the underworld and the guardian spirits through the will of Blue Star."
"The Ying clan has formed an alliance with the other eight royal families that have been on good terms with each other since the establishment of the Dragon Kingdom."
"After the alliance, the nine royal families have used all the manpower and material resources they can use."
"We are working together to find information about the descendants of all the civil servants, military generals, and strange people and strangers who have been left outside."
The First Emperor nodded with satisfaction and said, "Yes, this is a bit royal. This is a good idea."
The corners of Yinghong's lips curled up slightly when he heard this. The First Emperor's comments made him feel proud of himself.
After a pause, Yinghong continued.
"After finding information about the descendants of some civil servants, military generals, and strange people."
"The nine royal families sent out the most outstanding heirs from each family at that time."
"Go to lobby and win over the descendants of those civil servants and generals in history, as well as strange people and strangers."
